responses:
CORRECTION_ACCEPTED: yes

VERDICT: APPROVED with notes

REASONING: The PR correctly handles bounded cancellation and late-arriving stream packets by establishing clear boundaries across the parser, provider, and state-persistence layers. _late_abort_cleanup in mvp_site/main.py (~line 4603) cleanly detaches client connections and triggers provider cleanup without leaking pending background tasks. In mvp_site/llm_parser.py, stream_story_with_game_state (~line 1406) ensures that aborted runs do not mutate state post-cancellation, preserving transaction boundaries around persist_turn_atomic (~line 3307). Within mvp_site/llm_providers/gemini_provider.py, _InterruptibleStreamReader (~line 3348) and _await_cancellation_ack (~line 3553) cleanly decouple provider transport cleanup from watcher termination, enforcing a strict timeout defined by STREAM_CANCELLATION_LATE_ACK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS in mvp_site/constants.py (~line 278). This ensures late ACK frames are swallowed safely without stalling the main loop or interfering with the independent reservation TTL.

RISK: Low-to-moderate risk of lingering provider transport sockets consuming worker task capacity if STREAM_CANCELLATION_LATE_ACK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS triggers during prolonged upstream network hangs prior to full socket termination.

CONFIDENCE: high

COVERAGE:

mvp_site/main.py (_late_abort_cleanup)

mvp_site/llm_parser.py (stream_story_with_game_state, persist_turn_atomic)

mvp_site/llm_providers/gemini_provider.py (_InterruptibleStreamReader, _await_cancellation_ack)

mvp_site/constants.py (STREAM_CANCELLATION_LATE_ACK_TIMEOUT_SECONDS)

WEB SOURCES: none
